title: Originium Circuitry · Endfield Puzzle Helper
heading: Originium Circuitry Solver
intro: Upload the complete board, the constraints above and to the left, and all pieces on the right to recognize and solve. Recorded variants can also be loaded by code.

mode.screenshotNote: Recognize the complete board, constraints and stock
mode.codeNote: Look up valid puzzle variants in the catalog

capabilityMissing: Circuit support was not declared; submission is unavailable.

recognize.heading: Get an answer from your image
recognize.description: The previewed image is uploaded only when you click. A complete puzzle is always solved from this screenshot; the catalog only records and explains matches.

catalog.title: Puzzle catalog:
catalog.duplicate: · Image already recorded; not counted again
catalog.digestMismatch: · This image's previous puzzle differs; history unchanged
catalog.unavailable: Unavailable; a complete screenshot puzzle can still be solved

choice.title: Available catalog puzzles:
choice.line: The screenshot puzzle is incomplete. Code {{code}} has {{count}} valid variants; check them before choosing.

failure.busy: The service is busy. Retry later.
failure.invalidRequest: Image or puzzle rejected. Check it and retry.
failure.expired: Task expired or service restarted. Recognize again.
failure.network: Cannot connect to the puzzle service. Check your connection and retry.
failure.request: Request did not complete. Retry later.
failure.incomplete: Board found, but constraints, cells or pieces are incomplete. Include the whole board, all constraints above and to the left, and all pieces on the right.
failure.noBoard: Complete board not found. Include the whole board, constraints above and to the left, and all pieces on the right.
failure.alreadyCompleted: Puzzle already complete. Reset it in the game and take a new screenshot.
failure.invalidImage: The image is unreadable, unsupported or too large. Try another clear, complete screenshot.
failure.timeout: Recognition reached its time limit. Try another clear, complete screenshot.
failure.generic: Image recognition failed. Retry later or use another clear, complete screenshot.
failure.solveUnavailable: Recognition is complete, but circuit solving is unavailable. Retry later.
failure.solveResultUnknown: Unrecognized circuit solution returned. Retry later.
failure.recognitionResultMissing: The service did not return a valid recognition result. Please retry.
failure.taskFailed: The task failed. Please retry later.
failure.cancelled: Recognition or solving cancelled. Running server tasks may take a moment to end.

candidates.note: A code can have several valid variants. Check constraints, board and stock before choosing.

preview.targetsLabel: Row and column constraints by color
preview.fallbackColors: Original colors unavailable; using high-contrast example colors

result.invalidTitle: The service returned an invalid answer.
result.structureUnknown: Unrecognized response structure; answer not drawn.
result.ruleMismatch: Rule version differs from this page; answer not drawn.
result.unsatisfiableInvalid: A no-solution response unexpectedly contained placements or limit data.
result.unsatisfiable: This puzzle has no solution. All legal placements under the current rules have been searched.
result.timeout: The {{limit}} limit was reached. Search is incomplete, so solvability is still unknown.
result.paletteMismatch: Display colors do not match the puzzle; answer not drawn.
result.success: Answer verified. Each continuous colored piece is one stock shape; diamonds are fixed cells and stripes are obstacles.

query.heading: Load a puzzle by code
query.description: Load a validated puzzle by code. If several variants exist, compare constraints, board and stock before choosing.
query.label: Puzzle code
query.help: Use V + five digits or WL + four digits. Triangles, dashes and spaces are normalized automatically.
query.emptyCode: Enter V + five digits or WL + four digits, e.g. V40020 or WL0020.
query.autoSolve: Code {{code}} has one variant, submitted for solving automatically.
query.noCandidates: No complete catalog variant is available to solve.
query.solveUnavailable: Circuit solving unavailable. Please retry later.
query.errorInvalidCode: Invalid code. Use V + five digits or WL + four digits.
query.errorNotFound: No complete puzzle recorded. Use a screenshot first or check the code.
query.errorCatalogUnavailable: The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or use a screenshot.
query.errorNetwork: Cannot connect to the puzzle service. Check your connection and retry.
query.errorFailed: Lookup did not complete. Please retry later.

examples.screenshotIntro: Include the complete board (1) and all stock (2). The code (3) is optional.
examples.codeIntro: 1 is the board, 2 is stock, and 3 is the code to the left. Lookup only needs 3; no upload.
examples.figureAria: Illustration of an unsolved Originium Circuitry puzzle

workbench.intro: Import a screenshot to recognize and solve it in one step, or enter a puzzle code to fetch a recorded puzzle. A recognized puzzle's row and column numbers, obstacles and fixed cells can be checked and edited before solving again.
workbench.needsInput: Some values are missing or inconsistent, so solving stopped here. Fill in the items marked in red, then solve.
workbench.staleAnswer: The puzzle was edited; the answer below belongs to the previous version. Solve again.
workbench.helpEditTargets: Pick a colour above, then change that colour's number for each row and column.
workbench.helpEditCells: Click a cell to cycle: empty → obstacle → fixed cell of the current colour → empty.
workbench.helpEditPieces: Inventory pieces come from the screenshot and cannot be edited; if they are wrong, use another screenshot.

editor.cellHint: Click a cell to cycle: empty → obstacle → fixed cell of the current colour.

problems.targetInvalid: {{color}} {{axis}} {{index}} has a target outside the board.
problems.cellUnknown: Unrecognized cells: {{count}}. Click the cells marked in red to set them.
problems.fixedChannel: Fixed cells without a colour: {{count}}. Pick a colour and click them again.
